comments.value: This would still be useful to have.
yup, would be great to not have the mic icon shown except for the "Muted" icon when actively muted.
@{62dede40116f8244ab7062b8|full_name}: yes, Feb 2019, and still not implemented nice and then remove all mods
More than 3 years now, and still tracked and not implemented
@{5f483feb5903606f4f061101|full_name}: yeah... still though just giving this a bump. One can (only) dream...
Yeah could be good to finally implement that 5 minutes coding "mod" after more than 3 years. ;)

Having a HUD element stuck to my face gives me motion sickness, so i am forced to turn off the HUD to hide the mic icon. But then i cant recieve invites or requests from friends. This messes with my social life, and I dont have a choice because I dont want to throw up from motion sickness. I have other friends who feel the same way. Please implement a simple toggle for the mic icon.

Seeing the mic icon always on my face genuinely makes me uncomfortable like a eyelash in my eye and I don't want to turn off invites/requests. If the argument against this is people way not know they are muted and elad to unintended situations the hud toggle already causes this issue and its in the game! And tbh it's not a issue at all

I'm not arguing against the ability to hide the mic and other icons, but at the same time I propose to slightly change the shape and transparency of the mic during playback so that it's more noticeable.
Sometimes the HUD audio and silence mic icons are very hard to see. This is because the shape of the icon with and without sound is the same, but the transparency is only slightly different. This allows unintended audio to be heard by other players.
マイクやその他のアイコンを非表示にする機能に反対しているわけではありませんが、同時に、再生中にマイクの形状と透明度を少し変更して、より目立つようにすることを提案します.
HUD オーディオとサイレンス マイクのアイコンが非常に見にくい場合があります。これは、透明度がわずかに異なるだけで、アイコンの形状がサウンド付きとサウンドなしで同じであるためです。これにより、意図しない音声が他のプレイヤーに聞こえる可能性があります。
I would like the mic to go invisible when not talking personally, rather than completely gone.  Maybe as a multi option, that has a completely hide as well.

Very important for me is that turning it off gets saved (not like HUD disable, where it always comes back after restart).
Maybe this should a litte bit more advanced and become configurable hud. enable/disable like with finger indicator or face mirror
I would like it to turn off when unmuted so I don’t have to see that low opacity outline

details: I would love to have the option to hide the microphone indicator icon but not being forced to also hide friend/invite requests.
title: Toggle microphone HUD icon
